coordsystem.iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: Defined by FreeSurfer, the MRI (surface RAS) origin is at the center of a 256×256×256 mm^3 anisotropic volume (may not be in the center of the head).

decision.units_basis: value magnitudes and inter-contact spacing; coordsystem.json iEEGCoordinateUnits='m' judged a metadata error
decision.frame: MNI-like template space (RAS, mm); specific template to_verify: README says ICBM152 MNI, coordsystem.json says fsaverage (FreeSurfer fsaverage = MNI305 Talairach space). MNI305 vs ICBM152 differ by a near-identity affine (few mm), not resolvable from coordinate values alone
evidence: abs max coordinate 83.2155212722208: >1 so values cannot be metres for a head (would be >1 m)
median within-shaft nearest-contact spacing 9.34 (typical SEEG/ECoG pitch 3.5-10 mm)
100.0% of contacts inside MNI brain box [-80,80]x[-120,90]x[-70,90] mm
L-prefixed contacts with x<0: 1.0; R-prefixed with x>0: None (RAS orientation check)
